GPU-acceleration is activated when OpenSearch's vector ingestion rate (MB/
sec) is within a range. On OpenSearch domains, you have the ﬂexibility to
conﬁgure this range through index.knn.remote_index_build.size.min and
index.knn.remote_index_build.size.max. For example, with the lower range default of 50
MB, writing 15,000 full-precision vectors with 768 dimension between refresh intervals will trigger
GPU-acceleration by default.
Data is written with the following API operations:
• Flush
• Bulk
• Reindex
• Index
• Update
• Delete
• Force Merge
GPU-acceleration and write operations

Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
GPU-acceleration is activated with both automatic and manual segment merges.
